mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.7% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.7% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which triggers a policy response from the Federal Reserve, leading to lower long-term interest rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of monetary policy accommodation and reduces equity risk premiums, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 104.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 236.0 within one month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 236.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to produce a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strong aggregate demand, which raises expectations of future rate hikes and increases equity risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, signals labor market overheating, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE ≤ 5.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a supply-side shock with weak demand, which triggers a dovish policy pivot and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both INDPRO < 104.0 and UNRATE > 5.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
